column1: # Azure humanize acronym whitelist — applied by build_icon_index.sh azure_humanize()
# Format: <pattern><TAB><replacement>. Tab-separated; patterns may contain spaces.
# ORDER MATTERS: single-token acronym fixes first, then multi-token re-joins
# (a re-join may depend on a prior single-token fix, e.g. "Maria DB" needs "Db"->"DB").
# Extend as upstream introduces new mixed-case acronyms.
